attribution.issue: Initial self-check declaration before complete saved-source Read
attribution.evidence: Paid execution-evidence.json and source-exposure-audit.json: first attempted handoff at 23:27:48.971Z, corrective complete Read at 23:27:53.688Z

attribution.issue: Complete saved Read followed by successful incremental repair was rejected
attribution.evidence: Full Read 173/173 lines, then three native Edits at 23:28:13.960Z, 23:28:16.782Z and 23:28:18.978Z; final handoff rejected
attribution.rootCause: The gate conflated FileStateCache offset/timestamp read-dedup metadata with evidence of draft inspection. Native Edit intentionally sets offset/limit undefined while retaining updated content; this correctly invalidates read dedup but incorrectly invalidated the gate's inspection judgment.
attribution.responsibility: Our added gate design/implementation, not a native Edit bug. Earlier attribution of the terminal failure only to model failure to reread was incomplete.
attribution.fix: Complete BGS document Read establishes a normalized content hash in the existing bounded file cache. Successful native partial Edit advances it only when the before-image matches the inspected version. The stop gate compares this version to current disk content.
attribution.boundaries: Partial Read alone, Write, whole-body replacement, user-modified edit, or unexplained external content changes do not establish current inspection. Existing permission and read-dedup metadata remain unchanged.

attribution.category: Rejected repair assumption, caught by actual CLI
attribution.issue: Replaying old raw toolUseResult objects works on durable logs but fails in the live query
attribution.rootCause: src/query.ts deliberately removes raw toolUseResult payloads on each loop to bound memory. Durable transcript availability is not live query availability.
attribution.resolution: Removed receipt replay entirely. Preserve raw-payload cleanup; store only the current inspected version's 64-character hash, without new persistent ledgers, prompts or retries.
